title: Terminal drop types '' for a file with no path on disk
notes: src/page.ts:300 maps every dropped file through getPathForFile, which returns '' for a File with no file system path (an image dragged out of a web page). quoteForShell('') turns that into '', so the pane receives '' and a space instead of nothing. Skip empty paths before quoting. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/91 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/90#discussion_r4419537441

comments.body: PR #144: droppedPathsText skips empty paths, so a drop of a file with no path on disk types nothing. Version 2.32.11.
Shipped in PR #144: a dropped file with no path on disk is skipped instead of typing '' into the pane. Version 2.32.13.
